text: Election of the Chair of the Toronto and East York Community Council under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office starting December 11, 2018 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.

Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Elected Councillor Perks as Chair of the Toronto and East York Community Council for the term of office starting December 11, 2018 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
